messages.subject: stat_smooth and loess
parts:
Hi:
I am trying to change the default 95% interval of stat_smooth to
something like 80% but it doesn't seem to work when the default is
loess. Consider the example below:

library(ggplot2)
predd2 <-
cbind(cars,predict(loess(dist~speed,data=cars),se=T));head(predd2)
# The level argument inside stat_smooth()
fit <- ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = dist), data = predd2) +
geom_point() +
stat_smooth(size=1.5,colour='red') # stat_smooth() defaulting to 95%
intervals
fit
# So to change the level of confidence for loess manually I am doing
the following:
# Works fine
ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = dist), data = predd2) + geom_point() +
stat_smooth(fill='red',alpha=0.3) +
geom_line(aes(y=fit),colour='green',size=1.5,data=predd2) +
geom_line(aes(y=fit-
se.fit),colour='blue',size=1,linetype=2,data=predd2) +
geom_line(aes(y=fit
+se.fit),colour='blue',size=1,linetype=2,data=predd2)

# Estimate 80% intervals
alpha <- 0.20
predd2$interval <- qnorm(1- (alpha/
2))*predd2$se.fit
head(predd2)

# Doesn't work, it appears that stat_smooth still defaults to 95%
intervals
# ignoring the new 80% intervals
windows()
ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = dist), data = predd2) + geom_point() +
stat_smooth(aes(ymin=fit-interval,ymax=fit+interval),data=predd2) +
geom_line(aes(y=fit),colour='green',size=1.5,data=predd2) +
geom_line(aes(y=fit-
interval),colour='blue',size=1,linetype=2,data=predd2) +
geom_line(aes(y=fit
+interval),colour='blue',size=1,linetype=2,data=predd2)

Thanks in advance..

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: stat_smooth and loess
parts:
stat_smooth doesn't pay attention to ymin and ymax. It takes in the raw data, processes it to get the loess fit and 95% confidence region, and then draws the fit line and confidence region.

But since you've already calculated the fit and confidence interval yourself, you can use geom_line to draw the loess fit, geom_ribbon to make the shaded region, and get rid of stat_smooth.

library(ggplot2)
predd2 <- cbind(cars, predict(loess(dist ~ speed, data=cars), se=T))

# Estimate 80% intervals
alpha <- 0.20
predd2$interval <- qnorm(1- (alpha/2))*predd2$se.fit
ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = dist), data = predd2) + geom_point() +

geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=fit-interval, ymax=fit+interval), fill='blue',
              alpha=.2, data=predd2) +
  geom_line(aes(y=fit), colour='darkblue', size=1.5, data=predd2)


-Winston

I think I was able to figure it out. Since the se.fit of lowess has already been computed times 1.96, I can't do
predd2$norm_dist <- qnorm(1- (alpha/2))*predd2$se.fit
but I can use( I think):
 predd2$norm_dist <- qnorm(1- (alpha/2))*predd2$se.fit/1.96
 
So, for 80% intervals if I use:
alpha <- 0.20
# generate the lower and upper intervals

round(qnorm(1- (alpha/2)),2)
predd2$norm_dist <- qnorm(1- (alpha/2))*predd2$se.fit/1.96

predd2$Norm_LI <- predd2$fit - qnorm(1- (alpha/2))*predd2$se.fit  
predd2$Norm_UI <- predd2$fit + qnorm(1- (alpha/2))*predd2$se.fit   
 head(predd2)

ribbonCI <- ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = dist), data = predd2) + geom_point() +
stat_smooth() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=fit-se.fit, ymax=fit+se.fit), fill='goldenrod',
  alpha=.2,colour='red', data=predd2) +geom_line(aes(y=fit),
  colour='green', size=1.5, data=predd2);ribbonCI
ribbonCI + geom_ribbon(aes(y=fit,ymin=fit-norm_dist, ymax=fit+norm_dist), fill='lightblue',

alpha=.2,colour='blue', data=predd2,linetype=2)
 
Now I can see that the confidence bands are tighter
I would appreciate some input just to make sure that what I did is actually correct. Thanks
